Last time I came here it was okay, the job wasn’t done well but they fixed it for free on the second visit (just a few days after).

However, recently I came back here for a dental cleaning and what a mistake it was. Do not come here for a dental cleaning or anything related to that. It is extremely rushed and the price does not reflect what you get.

I paid 1300 THB for a 5 minute cleaning session (when it should’ve been 30+ minutes), that was on top of that extremely painful as the dentist was rushing to get it over with. Looking at my teeth, no real cleaning has been done..

I was also expecting to pay 900 THB, the advertised price, for such a short visit, but they bumped it to 1300.

End of all, I do not recommend anyone to come here.
